caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure positioned on a grey rectangular pedestal with inscriptions reading "SPORTING GOODS" on the left side and "TOBACCO AND CIGARS" on the front. The figure is dressed in a red dress trimmed with gold yellow patterns and a beige apron-like cloth draped from the waist. The person has a light brown complexion and is adorned with a beaded necklace, a blue and white sash, and an olive-green shawl draped over the left shoulder. The figure wears a gold headband with four large red and beige feathers sticking up at the back. In the right hand, the figure holds what appears to be a bundle, while the left holds a circular object. The base has the artist’s signature, “Eugene Crowe,” written in red on the lower right. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Cigar Store Indian
